text:
Sam: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp fails when it calls admin list routes via the Node SDK. SDK returns 404 but the exact curl works fine. Anyone seen this?
Maria D: Can you paste the curl + the SDK call you used?
Sam: Yep. Curl that succeeds:
```
curl -X GET \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/routes?projectId=p-123
```
Sam: Node SDK (failing):
```js
await client.admin.listRoutes({ projectId: 'p-123' })
// Error: 404 Not Found: no routes for project
```
Ajay: hmm. 404 with identical curl usually means query param name mismatch or serialization. Did you capture the outgoing request from the SDK?
Sam: I did a tcpdump — SDK call goes to `/v1/admin/routes?project_id=p-123` (underscore). The API expects `projectId` camelCase.
Maria D: ah, param-key rename in the API spec recently. SDK still maps to snake_case. That explains it.
Eva: This is a parity regression from the last API rename PR. The REST surface accepted both for a while but we tightened matching on the backend last week.
Sam: Workaround for now?
Ajay: You can call the raw client method as a workaround: `client.request('GET', '/v1/admin/routes?projectId=p-123')` — that avoids param mapping.
Sam: Verified — raw request works. Thanks.
Chris P: I'll open a quick SDK patch to map both `projectId` and `project_id` until we push a full fix. @sdk-bot create issue please.
sdk-bot: Created issue #3456 — "node-sdk: param-key serialization mismatch for admin.listRoutes" and linked to sampleapp report.
Chris P: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 — adds dual-key support + unit test.
Maria D: Nice. Can we add an integration test in CI that compares SDK-generated URL to a golden curl for all admin endpoints?
Eva: Yes please — this kind of drift is sneaky. Add a test and a changelog entry.
Sam: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Leaving this thread so folks know onboarding can fail because of the key rename. :+1:
Chris P: Will backport to latest patch release after review.
Maria D: Tagging the devex board: "sdk-parity" and adding reproduction steps.
Sam: Thanks everyone!
